paper_title: Searches for signatures of ultra-light axion dark matter in polarimetry data of the European Pulsar Timing Array
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (plotted as g_agamma/(10^-12 GeV^-1), multiplied by 1e-12)
notes: Axion-photon coupling limits from pulsar polarimetry birefringence in EPTA DR2, mass range 6e-24 to 5e-21 eV. Frequentist best sensitivity g_agamma=5e-13 GeV^-1 at ma=8e-24 eV; Bayesian conservative best g_agamma=2e-13 GeV^-1 at ma=3e-23 eV. Data points approximate from text as exact tabulated curve not provided; the upper limit is roughly flat ~2e-13 GeV^-1 across much of the range.
